description: This file declares internal API functions for the TLS Record Client object used in a transport layer security implementation. It includes function prototypes for accepting connections, receiving, and sending data over TLS.

methods.name: TlsRcoAccept
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a TLS connection request, processing a buffer of given size.

methods.name: TlsRcoRecv
methods.description: Receives data over an established TLS connection, storing the data in a buffer.

methods.name: TlsRcoSend
methods.description: Sends data over an established TLS connection from a given buffer.
